title: NHRP: Added dissection for ipv6
description: Dissector packet-nhrp.c doesn't work correctly with nhrp-packets on ipv6. I needed to dissect them so added dissection for ipv6 addresses and added nhrp as subdissector for ethertype. CGMP had code 0x2001 in ethertype although usually used 0x2000 so I chanded its code back to 0x2000 in order to give 0x2001 to NHRP. As I know NHRP-dissector used to work with ipv6 addresses but now it only has ipv4 address fields. Please, could you add it again?

notes.body: Cannot run pipelines due to not being verified. Please, could you run it manually?
`execinfo.h` is a GNU lib c header, I believe, and doesn't exist on other platforms. You don't seem to use it, anyway. Remove it.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/20170/diffs?diff_id=1387319129&start_sha=0b54481ef786c64deb918587d13cc10ab5e037d9#b2a08ff56facf12fbceddd5e5b83f5497f165e4d_20_20)
Why are you changing these back? (Probably because you loaded an older version of the file when updating a change you had made in your own tree before.)

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/20170/diffs?diff_id=1387329611&start_sha=12d95ffc4dd465b51b5c09d57b350f234549398b#59596d73e005fc3f0610a594b0b05b65b75082dc_262_262)

CISCO_PID_CGMP is 0x2001, because what Cisco actually uses inside Ethernet 802.3 with LLC/SNAP headers. 

https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/docs/switches/catalyst-6500-series-switches/10559-22.html

Over LLC/SNAP, Cisco uses 0x2000 for CDP (Cisco Discovery Protocol).

Those aren't Ethertype assignments, but it would seem to make more sense for the same value to be used. Do you have any evidence for your changes?
